title: Karnataka High Court refuses to quash ₹200 crore fraud case against ed-tech app co-founder
description: The Karnataka High Court on Thursday refused to quash criminal proceedings against the co-founder (petitioner) of ed-tech app, the V-Care Learning App, who is among those accused of defrauding the public to the tune of ₹200 crores [R Venkatesh v State of Karnataka].
